ValidationRule.description: Only the owner of the opportunity can modify its level of disclosure
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(disclosure_info_type__c), $User.Id <> OwnerId, NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name,'Administrator')), $Profile.Name <>'Desktop Integration', OR(RecordType.Name = $Label.DES_RT_Inside_opp, RecordType.Name = $Label.DES_RT_Inside_GM_opp ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Sorry, only the Owner of this opportunity can modify its level of disclosure.
